title: ge or dge at the End
rule: At the end of a word, look at the ONE letter right before the j sound. A short vowel alone: dge, like badge. A long vowel or a consonant: ge, like page and large.
trickText: Look at the ONE letter right before the j sound. Short vowel, all alone? Use d g e. Long vowel or consonant? Use just g e.
say: Today's case: d g e or g e. Look at the ONE letter right before the j sound. If it is a short vowel all alone, use d g e, like badge. If it is a long vowel or a consonant, use just g e, like page and large.

kinds.label: A long vowel (sneaky e)
kinds.say: a long vowel, with a sneaky e

activities.ruleStrip: Short vowel alone → dge  ·  Long vowel or consonant → ge
activities.instruction: Find the ONE letter before the j sound. Then choose dge or ge.
